BiblicalUsage: Fresh or green is the word for what is still moist and undried. In Genesis 30:37 Jacob takes "rods of green poplar" and peels white strakes in them, and in Ezekiel 17:24 God says He has "dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish."
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the green tree is the promise in one adjective: God dries up the green and makes the dry flourish, and He alone decides which tree stands and which falls.
